name: a jellyfish hanging in the air
description: A pale jellyfish hangs where the light fitting was, bell pulsing gently, trailing a metre of threads that drift on a current the room does not have.
looks: The bell opens and closes with a slow, regular deliberation. The light comes from inside it in soft pushes, brighter at the top of each stroke.
The trailing threads are hair-fine and faintly luminous, and they turn towards you when you get near, without hurrying.
There is a dark ring of something inside the bell, going round, that you decide not to think about too hard.
says: I am very slightly poisonous. It is nothing personal.
This is the deepest room I have been in.
Stand under me. I do not mind.
emotes: {it} pulses once, and the shadows in the room all lean and come back.
{it} drifts a hand-span to the left on a current that is not there.
{it} dims for a moment, and everything in the room goes the colour of deep water.
The threads under {it} coil up slowly and let themselves down again.
asks: Is it night out? I cannot ever tell in here.
Do you want it brighter? I can go brighter for a while.
